items.title: Hyperscalers List GPUs at Nearly 2× the GPU-Cloud Price, Fluence Research Finds
items.summary: The AI Compute Race report prices GPU compute outside the biggest buyers: a three-year commitment cuts the median price by 48%, while 17 of 22 tracked GPU models rose in price over the past year DALLAS, Texas – November 13, 2026 – Fluence has published The AI Compute Race, a report that prices GPU cloud compute for every company that is not a frontier lab or a hyperscaler. It was produced with research partners NEAR AI, io.net, Boundless, Phala, Gensyn, Fortytwo, Theta, Compute Labs and GAIB. Its central finding: where a company buys a GPU-hour sets the price. items.title: PPI for final demand increases 0.3% in October; goods advance 0.5%, services rise 0.2%
items.summary: The Producer Price Index for final demand rose 0.3 percent in October. Prices for final demand goods increased 0.5 percent, and the index for final demand services moved up 0.2 percent. Prices for final demand advanced 6.5 percent for the 12 months ended in October.

items.title: Bitcoin Optech Newsletter #431
items.summary: This week’s newsletter links to draft BIPs for exfiltration-resistant signing, summarizes the disclosure of three vulnerabilities affecting older versions of Bitcoin Core, announces a plan for mining the testnet5 genesis block, and describes an investigation into degraded compact block reconstruction. Also included are our regular sections announcing new releases and release candidates and describing notable changes to popular Bitcoin infrastructure software.

items.title: Solo Brings Human Verification to Venmo Co-Founder's JellyJelly App as AI Agents Beat CAPTCHA
items.summary: Solo’s SDK confirms that each JellyJelly account belongs to a real, unique person, after a Solo AI agent passed CAPTCHA on 50+ Discord servers. San Francisco, United States, November 13th, 2026 – Solo, a privacy-preserving proof-of-humanity company, is bringing its human verification software development kit (SDK) to JellyJelly. The social video app runs on Solana and was co-founded by Venmo co-founder Iqram Magdon-Ismail.
